title: job request
description: The first control frame (kind 'C') on a job channel, hub -> bench. Flat: op, then one key per parameter value, plus size/sha256 for image ops and board when the hub has a board chosen. A key that is none of these and not a parameter of the op is refused by the bench with BENCH_PARAM_REJECTED. No path and no command line ever rides this frame.

size.description: Image ops only: exact image length in bytes.

board.description: The board the hub has chosen; the bench uses it for the product identity check before a write.

additionalProperties.description: A parameter value keyed by ParamDesc.name: string (partition, enum, text), JSON integer (int; a decimal string is refused) or list of strings (argv).
